title: DetectHiddenFees Hidden Fee Index 2026
creator: DetectHiddenFees Research Lab

scope.geography: United States; scope will be recorded per source

field_definitions.source_url: Stable public URL supporting the record.
field_definitions.organization: Organization named by the source, when applicable.
field_definitions.document_type: Contract, estimate, invoice, policy, filing, or research source.
field_definitions.industry: Industry classification used for the record.
field_definitions.collection_date: UTC date on which the source was collected.
field_definitions.fee_terminology: Exact fee wording or a faithful normalized term.
field_definitions.fee_category: Controlled category assigned by the methodology.
field_definitions.fee_amount: Amount only when the source states an amount; otherwise null.
field_definitions.recurring: Whether the source describes a recurring charge; otherwise null.
field_definitions.contract_clause: Relevant clause or section reference, when applicable.
field_definitions.cancellation_requirements: Cancellation conditions stated by the source, when applicable.
field_definitions.renewal_terms: Renewal language stated by the source, when applicable.
field_definitions.evidence_reference: Page, section, line, or other traceable evidence location.
field_definitions.verification_status: pending, verified, disputed, excluded, or corrected.

limitations: No prevalence, amount, accuracy, or impact statistic is published in this manifest.
An empty records array means the public dataset has not passed the publication gate.
A record will be published only after its source, scope, evidence reference, and verification status are reviewed.
The dataset will not contain customer documents, personal information, or confidential contract text.

changelog.change: Created the public research manifest and collection schema; findings remain unpublished while evidence is collected and verified.
